context_items.title: HMAC-SHA256 Signature Header & Timing Attack Prevention
context_items.rationale: Inbound webhooks must be verified using X-Signature-256 header with HMAC-SHA256. To prevent timing attacks, comparisons must use constant-time hmac.compare_digest rather than standard equality operators.

context_items.title: Embedded Lightweight SPA Dashboard Architecture
context_items.rationale: To avoid complex Node/NPM build chains while fulfilling frontend requirements, serve a self-contained vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript dashboard directly from FastAPI static files mounted at root / with REST API polling for live status.

context_items.content: SQLite delivery storage should use WAL mode (PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL) to allow concurrent non-blocking reads from the dashboard while delivery worker writes event logs. Schema requires event_id, source_id, topic, payload, idempotency_key, status (DELIVERED, RETRYING, FAILED), and attempts count.

Webhook dispatch to target URLs must implement exponential backoff on HTTP 5xx responses or timeouts: initial_delay=0.1s, backoff_factor=2.0, max_retries=3. Permanent HTTP 4xx client errors must be marked as FAILED immediately without retry to avoid hammering bad endpoints.
